new_dependency_reasoning.syn: Real Rust AST parser (feature = full, for whole-file item + statement parsing). Chosen over regex/ad-hoc text scanning, which the R4.3 task explicitly forbids. De facto standard Rust parser crate.
new_dependency_reasoning.quote: ToTokens trait, used as a deterministic fallback stringifier for AST fragments not hand-modeled by adapter::semantic::rust::spelling (e.g. array-length const expressions, trait objects, impl Trait).
new_dependency_reasoning.proc-macro2: Span/TokenStream types syn is built on; feature = span-locations enabled directly so line/column source spans are available outside an actual proc-macro invocation (this extractor never runs as a proc-macro; it only links the crate as a library).
